senses.gloss:
ājya
(‘[that which is] thrown into [the fire]’; ‘[that which is] smeared with oil’)
------------------------------------------
Offering oblations (homa) into a duly consecrated fire is an important part of Vedic rituals. Melted butter, generally used in such oblations is called आज्य. When no specific material is prescribed for a होम, आज्य can be used. Though cow’s ghee is preferred as the best, (she-) buffalo’s ghee or sesame oil may also be used for the purpose.
Ājyabhāga is the name given to the two libations of आज्य offered to सोम and अग्नि preceding the principal oblation in the Darśa sacrifice.
